title: audit detail agent.identity
description: detail of audit rows with action agent.identity: an agent that held its user's identity converted itself into an agent with its own identity (ADR-082 section 5); gen is the generation of its certificate. Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
